entities.name: Okaun
entities.description: Green-skinned, horned cyclops of Kylem, the Eye of Chaos, partner of Zndrsplt.

entities.name: Zndrsplt
entities.description: Small one-eyed blue homunculus and former penalty mage, the Eye of Wisdom, who rides on Okaun's shoulder and speaks telepathically through him.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: Plane Okaun and Zndrsplt are from.

entities.name: Valor's Reach
entities.description: Place on Kylem where they fight together.

relations.quote: Okaun and Zndrsplt are partners and friends who fight together in Valor's Reach on Kylem.
